blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) celebrated another milestone as it was recently selected as the Outstanding Developer for its Residential project The Trion Towers, a one-hectare property in Bonifacio Global City. The award was given by the FIABCI (Fédération Internationale des Administrateurs de Biens et Conseils lmmobiliers) Philippines Property &amp; Real Estate Awards, the local chapter of the prestigious Paris-based real estate association. RLC President Frederick D. Go was also recognized as a Fellow in Real Estate Management.
